name: @ship/test-setup
description: Shared vitest/jsdom setup harness for SAIL component packs: JSDOM polyfills (ResizeObserver, matchMedia, Popover, Dialog, ToggleEvent, PointerEvent) + lucide-icon-map loader, the repo-agnostic suiComponentVitestConfig() factory, renderView/renderComponent, and the lightweight mount/flush/createContainerRegistry container helpers. One source of truth so consuming packs stop rolling their own test-utils.
